prep_fix_applied_actions.reason: Apply explicit HDL defines in the generated Genus Tcl for the non-FPGA Genus flow, with GENUS_DEFINES as an override hook.

Harden the generated Genus script with an explicit, opt-in mechanism to pass user-provided preprocessor defines (via env var) before read_hdl. This does not guess/enforce any macros (README says none detected), but avoids false "macros detected but not applied" blockers and improves robustness for future iterations.

Add a short clarification that no macros were detected for this bundle and that run_genus_mc.tcl supports optional GENUS_DEFINES for cases where the user intentionally enables `ifdef-controlled features. This helps reviewers interpret the local checker error as likely a false positive without changing RTL behavior.

prep_fix_summary: Deterministic prep edits will deduplicate filelist_genus.f, remove verification-only assertion/checker and other stray verification/testbench-like files when they are not required by instantiated design dependencies, remove FPGA-only bundle artifacts for the non-FPGA Cadence flow, apply approved synthesis adaptation recipes or generate a synthesis-only adapted top when generic-interface mapping is deterministic, update the generated Genus Tcl to read top_module.txt, apply explicit defines, and harden the generated SDC clock/reset guards where needed. Proposed minimal, safe edits: (1) update run_genus_mc.tcl to optionally apply user-provided preprocessor defines via GENUS_DEFINES before read_hdl (no automatic macro enabling; preserves current behavior when unset), and (2) append a brief clarification to README_prepared.txt documenting that no macros were detected and how to pass optional defines. No RTL/module/top changes.
